posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Just to mention it: the event option you'd have wanted to use here is "
Designation with variables
", not "Direct designation". Simply multiplying the tile coordinates by the tile size would only be correct if the top-left tile of the map were on-screen.
You can get the screen coordinates of a character using the
Control Variables
command. E.g. with only a couple of reusable variables:
Control Variables: Target X -> Set ->
Game Data
->
Character
-> This Event ->
Screen X
.
Control Variables: Target Y -> ...etc... ->
Screen Y
.
Show Picture: 2 ->
Designation with variables
-> { Target X, Target Y }.
Control Variables: Target Y -> Sub -> 96. (I.e. move up 96 px.)
Move Picture: 2 ->
Designation with variables
-> { Target X, Target Y }.
[Edit: corrected "Map X|Y" to "Screen X|Y".
]
